title: Power of Communication
summary: PP Ujwal Andhari conducted a one-hour interactive session on the Power of Communication for approximately 250 Grade 7 students at SCD Barfiwala High School.
description: PP Ujwal Andhari conducted a one-hour interactive session on the Power of Communication for approximately 250 Grade 7 students at SCD Barfiwala High School. The session covered the importance of everyday communication, overcoming the fear of public speaking, crafting powerful messages, effective listening, and the role of tone, facial expressions and body language. Students participated enthusiastically through questions, answers and short presentations. Students who gave good or correct answers received books on the Power of Communication by renowned author Dale Carnegie. Appreciating the session, the school principal requested another session on the same topic for teachers and staff.
location: SCD Barfiwala High School, Mumbai, Maharashtra
